list_prices.source: The price table in cost-derive.py, stage 2 of the rs cost refresh: the list prices in cairn-analytics pricing.rs, table reviewed 2026-10-20. A model key outside the table prices at zero, as in the derivation of summary.json.

subscriptions.source: The operator, 26 Oct 2026: the swarm ran on six Claude Max (20x) plans by the end of the run and one ChatGPT Pro plan, $200 a month each, $1,400 a month in all, shared with other projects. The page prorates all seven over the whole window by the average month (365.25 / 12 days); fewer Max plans ran early in the window, so the figure is at most what the window cost.
